all_findings.resolution: Root must seal actual bindings, prescribed exact data manifest hashes and one same-seed donor/device/runtime block; current templates remain disabled.
all_findings.title: Bind exact actual jobs, plan, TRAIN projection and donor provenance

all_findings.resolution: Independent root activation adapter must compare all five fit-job comparison block, donor, origin, plan, data, device and runtime rows before launch.
all_findings.title: Enforce same comparison block across each five-arm seed group

all_findings.resolution: Bind existing direct-child supervision with finite time/GPU/RSS/output/log caps, child-start-to-terminal and failure costs, staging/donor acquisition ledger, all15 successful exits and one fixed scoring attempt per seed; internal timers alone are incomplete.
all_findings.title: Require owned terminal receipts, complete costs and attempt custody before scoring

all_findings.interpretation: TRAIN-only downstream fits are valid for this development scope; fresh confirmation remains needed.
all_findings.title: Development donor was selected on the same validation population

all_findings.interpretation: Equal target coverage is not equal update gradients; no persistent semantic specialization is induced or assumed.
all_findings.title: Complementarity changes cyclic target order without cross-path coupling

all_findings.interpretation: Equal active path budgets and near-equal heads do not make objectives, function classes or optimizer timing identical; broader native superiority is untested.
all_findings.title: Matched capable single is a procedure control within the frozen family

all_findings.interpretation: SSL norm includes decoder and graph parameters; class norm includes graph and head with CE+Brier. Finite gradients can be zero; no extra diagnostics required for source release.
all_findings.title: Aggregate gradient norms do not prove the weak-supervision premise

all_findings.interpretation: Accuracy/NLL/Brier and saved probabilities are implemented; separate calibration, common-wrong, disagreement and equivalence claims need bounded interpretation.
all_findings.title: Secondary diagnostic scope is incomplete and statistical matches are undefined

all_findings.interpretation: No frameworks, data/checkpoint payloads, GPU work or remote hosts were accessed.
all_findings.title: Static review cannot verify numerical feasibility or payload custody
